title: omphalobium africanum
intro: Omphalobium africanum, commonly known as "African milk tree", is a plant species belonging to the Annonaceae family. It has been traditionally used in West African folk medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Omphalobium africanum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
